verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI that answers questions with citations from workspace content. The only AI-related item is official ChatGPT/Claude/MCP support. That lets external assistants reach Basecamp data, but those assistants would generate the answers, and nothing documents citations. This counts as adjacent integration plumbing rather than the story's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
